description.value: We investigated the expectation and receipt of food reward compared with monetary reward in patients with BTE.

spans.text: Therefore, we investigated the expectation and receipt of food reward compared with monetary reward in patients with BTE.

value: We hypothesized that BTE patients would exhibit heightened food reward sensitivity.

Specifically, we expected increased activation in the mesocorticolimbic reward system, i.e. the ventral striatum (VS), during anticipatory food intake ( O'Doherty et al. , 2002 ; Simon et al. , 2014b ) and increased activation in the medial and lateral OFC during the receipt of food reward ( Rolls, 2007 ; Simon et al. , 2014b ) but intact processing of monetary reward.
Additionally, we expected to observe close associations between alterations in neural food reward processing and dysfunctional eating behavior.
